rules.title: One step per branch
rules.rule: Work happens on step/<id>-<slug>, plan changes on plan/<slug>. Only the active step changes status, evidence, completedAt and notes. The pmo check enforces scope, imports, plan integrity and commit format.
rules.note: Hooks are installed by step 1.1.3; until then run npm run pmo -- check by hand.

rules.title: Finish by updating the PMO
rules.rule: Before reporting a task done, set the step's status, evidence and completedAt, or add the follow-up on a plan branch, then run npm run pmo -- check. Work with no step is not finished until one exists.

rules.title: Safe rendering
rules.rule: Every value interpolated into HTML is escaped, preferably through the safe html template. Existing unescaped interpolations in src/main.js are being removed in step 1.2.3; new code must not add any.
rules.note: Existing code violates this; step 1.2.3 closes the gap and promotes it to a test.

rules.title: Secrets are never committed
rules.rule: Secrets live in .env.local (git-ignored). Settings that are not secret are documented in .env.example. .env is never committed.
